title: Tray Icons settings window is closed when you open settings of one of its entries
line: Opening an entry's settings from the System Tray settings, in a panel or on the desktop, now keeps the System Tray settings open with their unapplied changes.
explanation: Settings requests from applets inside the System Tray reach the view that holds the tray: PanelView for a tray in a panel, DesktopView for a tray on the desktop. Both kept a single applet settings window, so opening a tray entry's settings deleted the open System Tray settings window and its unapplied changes. Applets configured through a KCM were unaffected because they open System Settings instead. A new shared helper, NestedConfigView, used by both views, opens the settings of an applet nested inside the applet being configured in a second window, transient for the first; any other applet, and any applet of the desktop containment when the desktop settings are open, still replaces both windows as before.

commits.message:
shell: open tray entry settings on top of the tray settings

Opening an entry's settings from the System Tray settings, in a panel or
on the desktop, replaced that window and lost its unapplied changes. The
settings of an applet inside the configured one now open in a new window.

BUG: 484710
